claims.statement: MPO-attention with bond dimension chi achieves || A - A_MPO ||_F <= sqrt(sum_{i=chi+1}^n sigma_i^2(A)) + delta(chi)
The attention mechanism with beta = 1/sqrt(d) has an effective Lipschitz constant C(beta) = beta/4
Within each MERA level l, the attention computation is equivariant under permutations that preserve the binary tree topology.
